title: 60-Second Alliance Reset
concept: An emergency one-minute reset for when winning has replaced connecting. It stops the damage fast, then books real time to actually work it out.
whenToUse: Use when you're still in the room together, it's turned into a fight to win, and you're both willing to stop for one minute before a longer pause.
steps: Stop — quit trying to win or solve it.
Say it — “I want to connect, not fight.”
Touch — a brief touch, only if it's welcome.
Return — pick an exact time to keep talking.

phrases.text: I want to connect, not fight.
I’m stopping so we don’t do damage.

working: Mid-fight in the kitchen. A: “I’m stopping. I want to connect, not fight.” A hand on the shoulder, if welcome. Three breaths. “Can we talk at 8pm?” B agrees. They leave it there until 8.
notWorking: Using the reset to shut the conversation down for good: “60-second reset — I’m done,” with no time to come back. That’s just walking away with extra steps. Always pair stopping with a real return time.
activity: Practice the five steps on a fake topic (“dishes”) three times while you’re both calm. Agree on the phrase you’ll actually use.
